citation: Wermers, Yao and Zhao (2012, RFS 25(12)) Forecasting stock returns through an efficient aggregation of mutual fund holdings
formula: gia_13f (engine-only C++ kind, atx-engine gia_13f_field.hpp, formula id gia-13f-skill-wavg-v1): per 13F quarter P, each filer's skill = mean excess holdings return (own value-weighted 13F holdings return minus the aggregate 13F book's) over quarters P-7..P (at least 6), u = centered rank of skill among the filers (at least 3); value of a stock = holding-weight-weighted mean u of its skilled holders (at least 5); read from the session after the quarter's 13F filings are all visible (filing date + 46 h) while the quarter is at most 150 days old; higher = held by managers with better past holdings returns
domain: NaN before a fresh visible 13F quarter in which the line has a mapped position, with fewer than 5 skilled holders, and more than 150 days after the quarter end; the stage holds 13F from 2013q2, so the first value needs 8 filing quarters (2015)
deviation: managers are 13F filer CIKs, not funds; skill is the rank of trailing excess 13F holdings returns at implied quarter-end prices, not WYZ's generalized-inverse alpha of reported fund returns; one variant, constants fixed blind (8 / 6 quarters, 5 holders, 3 managers, half coverage, the stage's 150-day staleness)
notes: horizon class slow, half-life 63 sessions (PM8-5: the ownership_flow theme's, quarterly 13F books predicting the following quarter, WYZ's quarterly rebalanced portfolios); bar of lit section 3.0 argued from the mechanism, not measured: the information is manager skill, which momentum, value and earnings quality do not span (WYZ), and the closest member stio_trade ranks quarterly ownership changes, not who holds; but lit 3.1 F3 estimates rho .15 to the themes, above the .1 bar, so the mechanism argument is the only case for it and root's screen decides; capacity high (quarterly turnover)
predicted_mechanism: managers whose own past 13F holdings beat the aggregate 13F book hold value-relevant information, so the holdings-weighted skill of a stock's holders predicts its next-quarter return, slowly impounded because 13F books are public 45 or more days late
